title: Rate, Explain and Cite (REC): Enhanced Explanation and Attribution in Automatic Evaluation by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on the CoBBLEr (Cognitive Bias Benchmark for LLMs as EvaluatoRs) dataset to measure implicit and induced biases—such as order bias, bandwagon effect, compassion, selective bias, salience, distraction, and frequency—during pairwise comparisons of LLM-generated responses.
